source.title: WHO guidelines on physical activity and sedentary behaviour

groups.label: Children (under 13)
groups.text: Aim for an average of 60 minutes a day of moderate-to-vigorous activity (ages 5-12), mostly aerobic, including bone and muscle strengthening on at least 3 days a week. Use pediatric advice, not adult plans.

groups.label: Adolescents (13-17)
groups.text: Aim for an average of 60 minutes a day of moderate-to-vigorous activity, including vigorous aerobic, bone and muscle strengthening on at least 3 days a week.

groups.label: Adults (18-64)
groups.text: 150-300 minutes of moderate activity or 75-150 minutes of vigorous activity per week, plus muscle strengthening on 2 or more days. Starting lower and building gradually is fine.

groups.label: Older adults (65+)
groups.text: Same weekly aerobic targets as adults, plus varied activity emphasising balance and strength on 3 or more days a week to prevent falls.
